hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured • Free Quotes • Local Leeds Team
hero_subhead: From interior refreshes to complete exterior overhauls, we transform your space on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full property redecoration, we handle interior and exterior work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We refresh living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and hallways with expert prep work and premium finishes. Every surface is primed and painted to last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior paint, wood treatment, and cladding work. We prep properly to resist Leeds weather.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Create impact with contemporary or traditional wallpaper, including bold feature walls. Precise hanging, clean edges, professional finish.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Paint skirting boards, doors, frames, and built-in joinery to a furniture-quality standard. We use quality primers and finishes that don't chip.

services.title: Commercial Decoration
services.desc: Refresh offices, retail spaces, and hospitality venues with minimal disruption. We work evenings and weekends to suit your schedule.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Repair
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. We fill cracks, sand surfaces, and strip old paint so your new finish looks flawless and lasts years longer.

about_pullquote: Proper preparation beats rushing the job every single time.
about_para_1: InEx Decorators has been transforming Leeds homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started because we were tired of seeing poor-quality paintwork and rushed jobs. From our base in Low Moor, we've built a reputation for meticulous prep work, colour advice, and finishes that stand the test of time.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate speaks volumes — most people call us back when they need decorating work, and many recommend us to friends and neighbours. We're insured, reliable, and we turn up when we say we will. Every job, whether it's a single bedroom or a full commercial fit-out, gets the same attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About InEx Decorators

reviews.text: Couldn't fault them. Decorated our lounge and hallway over three days. Very tidy workers, all prep work done properly, and the finish is brilliant. They moved furniture carefully and left no mess. Already got them back for the landing and bedrooms. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on our dining room and feature wall. Paul came round, listened to what we wanted, gave us some really good colour suggestions, and the price was fair. Work started on time and finished early. Quality of paintwork is immaculate. Don't bother ringing round — phone these guys.
reviews.author: Sarah D.

reviews.text: Had our whole exterior painted — woodwork, gutters, the lot. It's held up brilliantly through the winter. They did all the prep work properly, took care of our plants, and were professional throughout. Getting them back to do the inside next year.
reviews.author: James B.
